paragraphs: Evisions makes reporting, document and payment software for colleges and universities. Higher education is its only market, a point the company states plainly. Argos is the enterprise reporting product, FormFusion covers document design and delivery, and IntelleCheck is the renamed version of an early check printing tool.

Argos lets faculty and staff pull the reports and data they need without waiting on IT. The tools are pitched to work whether an institution runs on-premise, on SaaS, or somewhere in between. FormFusion and IntelleCheck automate the creation and delivery of documents, forms and checks. A newer addition, Argos Data Agent, answers plain-English questions against the DataBlocks and reports a campus already uses.

The company counts more than 900 partner institutions. They range from public to private, two-year to four-year, domestic to international. Kevin Jones started the business as a consulting firm before it became a software company. It has a partnership with Ellucian that it renewed for another five years. One published case study credits Argos with cutting report lead time by 85 percent at the University of Idaho.

quote.text: Evisions serves all varieties of Higher Education institutions: public and private, large and small, 2-year and 4-year, domestic and international.
